title: Sociedad y poder
goal: Read how power, religion and social rank actually worked in Maya, Mexica and Inca society, and talk about what mobility looked like in each.

items: Explain why a Maya king's authority was seen as religious, not just political.
Describe how a Mexica commoner could rise in social rank.
Explain what the Inca mit'a was, and why it existed instead of money taxes.
Contrast how the Mexica and Inca governed conquered territory.
Use se pasiva to describe how an institution worked.
I can explain why a Maya king's authority was seen as religious, not just political.
I can describe how a Mexica commoner could rise in social rank.
I can explain what the Inca mit'a was, and why it existed instead of money taxes.
I can contrast how the Mexica and Inca governed conquered territory.
I can use se pasiva to describe how an institution worked.
